Revision 142 | Coordinator: /root | Latest complete matrix remains v218: 1/32 cells and 399/432 checks passed. The next full matrix remains unstarted. G6-054 stays parked.
The fresh focused run on 4e90b0af / generation 449 is closed. All original ownership, source, SDK and executable guards passed. Audio passed 6/6 routes, A/V sync passed 6/6, and the approved single-cycle ownership/resource observation passed. Raw video passed 0/6 because 22 repeated authored canvas markers remain unresolved by the original-source witness; every other video predicate passed, with zero repeated receiver RTP frames. The original CLI exited 1 and the component remains failed. No historical result is being regraded.
V219-RTC-OWNERSHIP — Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. The real service now exported 10 complete mapping summaries covering 14 epochs. This verifies that the repaired strong-reference cycles release the mapping histories in the normal focused runtime. The 20 lifecycle/media checks and five real logging-filter/default checks remain component evidence, not matrix passes.
V219-PUBLIC-EPOCH-WITNESS — Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. Implementation in progress. The current witness excludes moved receivers even during their stable public intervals and caps pairs at 16. Its successor must validate the exact original public ownership chain on both source and receiver, prove every repeated marker against the correct Core epoch and closed packet capture, and exercise a mandatory passive wire control even when no marker repeats. Private, unknown, cross-owner and repeated original-source frames remain failures. Raw media quality limits are unchanged. The independently reviewed design uses bounded compact evidence, exact epoch/window indexing, explicit overflow failures and no new media-path operations.
V219-NUMERIC-ICE — Owner: fixture_blockers; reviewer: media_blockers (source), v198_resources (actual results); coordinator: Root. Applied and independently verified: all six Node checks pass. Only the explicitly requested disposable Firefox witness profile disables host-address obfuscation. A separate native capability probe confirmed default local candidate stats use mDNS while the witness profile exposes numeric addresses; both original Firefox engines and the Node owner closed naturally. This proves preference effect, not Connect packet matching or a matrix result.
Earlier verified fixes remain in place: fresh receive-work deadlines, closed-Core timer handling, bounded log scanning and original-source mapping exports. The last 449 failure is preserved in tracked evidence. The remaining exact wire proof can still expose a genuine media issue; advancing receiver RTP alone is insufficient.
Next: complete the public-epoch witness and independent review, run its focused/unit controls, then run a fresh normal focused programme with exact native stats/Core/wire proof. After that passes, reconcile and execute the complete current regression, local ARM source preparation/tests, normal release checks and final preflight. No full 32-cell run starts during this preparation phase.
